summary: Tested 4 backend payment fixes for Stripe refactor: (1) downgrade sets flag not tier, (2) price IDs from env, (3) legacy /api/cancel-subscription removed, (4) webhook signature enforced. Created /app/backend/tests/test_payment_fixes_i30.py with 13 pytest cases covering login, auth/check + account/subscription downgrade fields, legacy endpoint removal, webhook 400 (missing + invalid sig), checkout auth + basic/advanced/invalid plan, sync auth, downgrade auth. Found & fixed 1 minor bug: webhook 'Missing Stripe-Signature' path returned 500 instead of 400 because HTTPException was swallowed by generic Exception handler; added `except HTTPException: raise` passthrough. All 13 tests pass. Frontend smoke: login works, dashboard reaches /app (pre-existing Privacy gate modal), zero console errors.

minor.issue: HTTPException(400 Missing Stripe-Signature) was caught by generic except Exception and rethrown as 500. FIXED — added except HTTPException: raise before generic handler.

action_items: None — all payment refactor items verified. If plan to add more custom HTTPExceptions in stripe.py, keep the `except HTTPException: raise` guard in place.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/stripe.py webhook had ordering: HTTPException raised inside try was swallowed by generic Exception handler and rethrown as 500 — always place `except HTTPException: raise` before generic `except Exception` (now fixed).

routes/stripe.py:131 — STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET missing returns 500 (correct per spec), but Stripe re-tries webhooks aggressively on 5xx; consider a 200 no-op + admin alert if the secret is unset in prod (edge case).

PRICE_TO_PLAN dict is built at module import time from env; if env vars are None the dict has None keys — resolution still works but silent misconfig would cause tier resolution to fall through to metadata. Consider fail-fast assertion on module load.
routes/auth.py:487 still exposes POST /api/account/cancel-subscription (correct, this is the new path). Legacy /api/cancel-subscription confirmed removed (returns 405).

success_rate.frontend: smoke passed (login + dashboard load, no console errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full downgrade flow can only be tested with a live Stripe subscription (real customer with advanced sub). Route existence + auth guard verified. Webhook secret is configured in backend/.env. All 4 payment fixes verified end-to-end at the API contract layer.
